notes.title: Season 3 & Battle of the Dancers is out now for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale!
notes.content:
Season 3 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is OUT NOW!

Hey Flock! 👋 Season 3 is now out for Headbangers, which sees the arrival of our brand new gamemode: Battle of the Dancers. Ready for 1v1 rhythm battles to a selection of new tracks? Discover more by watching our Season 3 Launch Trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=hmEkd7G0woA;full][/previewyoutube]🪩 Battle of the Dancers: How to Play
In Battle of the Dancers, the last Pigeon standing wins... or you could say it is Owl or nothing! Your aim to play the music in rhythm, without any mistakes. Hit all buttons in a row without any mistakes and you’ll begin filling up your fireball gauge. When this fills, you’ll send a devastating fireball at your opponent, which lowers their health bar. The pigeon with the most health at the end of the round is the winner and can deal the final blow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/305bb5d21b3cce0a908ac5d54af21bbe39495c01.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/854fbcb2c559f2f9293fd3a7f2c07c34b15b91f6.gif

We are happy to introduce our new Challenge Skin for Season 3... The Painter Pigeon. Unlock this skin by completing in-game challenges and become an art icon just like the famous painters Pigecasso and Michelangelcrow!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/c8df3777ac26f906c228badd392a8109378b46f1.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/7159c746ec7583478792126ca5a46a12f51c8d31.gif
Steam Cloud Saves

We'd recommend to players who've played Headbangers: Rhythm Royale on multiple devices to play first on your device with the local save that you'd want to keep from 4 April 2024 14:00 BST onwards. This is to ensure the correct save file is uploaded to Steam Cloud.

We're excited to implement Steam Cloud Save and for progress to translate between players' multiple devices. For Multi-PC and Steam Deck users, we hope this feature helps you hit all the levels on your new Season 3 Battle Pass!

notes.title: Steam Deck Performance Settings I Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
notes.content:
Hey Flock! 👋🐥

Today we want to highlight a workaround for any Steam Deck users experiencing issues with Headbangers: Rhythm Royale. We've found that Headbangers performs better on Steam Deck after following these steps:
 Open the Steam Menu by pressing the button labelled 'Steam' on your Steam Deck
 Select 'Settings' from the list and then select 'System'.
 Scroll down to 'System Options' and enable 'Developer Mode'
 Go back to the Settings list and select 'Developer'
 Scroll down and deselect 'Enable WiFi Power Management'

Season 2 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is Out Now for Steam!
Hey Flock! Today we are extremely excited to welcome you to a brand new season of Headbangers Rhythm Royale. But what's new for the Pigeons in our free Season 2 update? 🐥

NEW COSMETICS
The new season of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale brings all new cosmetics including the Mad Scientist Pigeon, the Cow Pigeon, the Courgette Pigeon and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/214fbeb4b169f0de99a9caecff34b3f3b5dec17c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/5763c0b91d081e500c15eef41d83da3dc7a4eb33.gif
FRESH AND FREE BATTLE PASS
In Season 2, you will find a fresh Battle Pass containing 30 new levels! The Battle Pass in Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is completely free, so all players can jump in today and start gaining XP for your Battle Pass levels! The Season 2 Battle Pass contains all new cosmetics items including new Full Outfits, Individual Items, Taunts, Voices and more!

We've been listening to all players feedback around the Season 1 Battle Pass and it's functionality. From this, we have decided to make some tweaks based off your suggestions! For Season 2, we've increased the amount of XP needed for each individual level. We hope this is a greater challenge for all and that it makes our Battle Pass feel even more rewarding!

Remember Flock, you gain more XP by progressing further in each game of Headbangers so do whatever it takes to stay in each round of rhythm chaos! We hope you are ready to test your Headbangers skills to see if you can unlock our Level 30 Full Costume: The Cinema Pigeon!

In Season 2, we have a brand new Challenge Skin in The Boxer Pigeon! Unlock this skin in Headbangers: Rhythm Royale by completing twelve new in-game challenges.

Didn't unlock all of the Challenge Skins in Season 1? Don't worry, we've got you! All previous Challenge Skins from Season 1 are featured in Season 2, with all your Challenge progression carrying over from the previous Season.

We've opted to not reset Crumbs progress for multiple reasons. Firstly, players can begin purchasing the new cosmetic items from the very start of the Season. Secondly, we've seen you all working hard to earn more Crumbs even after you've completed the Shop and bought all the cosmetic items in Season 1. This dedication to Headbangers is amazing and deserves to be celebrated. We are genuinely grateful for the amount of hours you've played our Rhythm Battle Royale game for!

If you have any feedback around this change or any other Season 2 tweaks, please get in touch with us in our Headbangers Discord Server! We have a dedicated player feedback channel and frequently update the community regarding changes for Headbangers: https://discord.gg/n35cwGy6nP

notes.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale I Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hey Flock! 👋🐤 

The third hotfix is now live for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale for all platforms! Hotfix 3 reduces the lobby timer to 60 seconds and contains fixes to the lobby backfill bugs, fixes to specific challenges and more.

Before we soar into more information around the hotfix, we would like to inform the community that the team are working on an issue surrounding a network error, preventing some players from launching the game. Once we have a fix, we will update the community with this news. We hope to have a fix for this soon across all platforms and appreciate the community's patience while we remedy this issue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/8d8310be37b8cc70e4502d3d44c07a09a3e536a9.png
Hotfix 3 - Lobby Changes:
After listening to players' feedback from our launch week, we have altered the lobby timer and fixed an issue surrounding lobby backfill! 🤟

At launch, our lobby timer was set to 120 seconds. Many players stated that this timer was too long, that players were leaving lobbies before the two-minute mark and that we should reduce this timer. With Hotfix 3, we have reduced this timer to 60 seconds. Now, players will spend less time in the lobby menu and more time playing our rhythm minigames! 🎧

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/e507051327c1049967fac8206e39ceaa86e86222.gif

On our October 31st launch, many community members noticed a bug around players leaving lobbies. When a player left an open lobby, a bug caused the lobby to never refill back to 30 players. In Hotfix 3, we have fixed this issue with server backfill. With Hotfix 3, if players leave during the timer screen, the lobby can still fill back to 30 players. Full lobbies for all! 🥳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/478bb3dcd5da7f531ad4a74e4bb6aec92b67fd76.gif

⬇️ Full patch notes for Hotfix 3 can be found below:
PATCH NOTES - HOTFIX 3
 Reduced the lobby waiting time to 60 seconds.
 Fixed an issue with the server backfill to ensure remaining free slots in a lobby are filled with players.
 Fixed an issue where the challenge outfit for the Aubergine skin would not unlock if a disconnection occurs.
 Fixed an issue around Crumb Unlocks. Future crumb level unlocks in the battle pass will be rewarded as the bug around Crumb Unlocks, which would sometimes not be awarded, is now fixed.*
 Fixed an issue where the sound effects would be missing when using the Team17 overlay.
*At this moment, we have fixed this issue for future Crumbs Level unlocks. If you unlocked a crumbs pack before Hotfix 3 and encountered this issue, your Crumb total will not be fixed. We will continue the investigation into this issue and provide further information around this bug in the future.

We want to thank the community for your detailed feedback and your overall patience, whilst our team has investigated these issues!

SUPPORT
If you run into any server issues or any other problems with Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please don’t hesitate to contact our Support Team.

DISCORD

notes.content:
Headbangers: Rhythm Royale soars onto your screens and launches today on all platforms! 

Headbangers challenges players to take on 29 player-controlled Pigeons across four increasingly tense rounds, testing their memory, rhythm, reflexes, reaction time, and most importantly… their ability to rap! Want to see more of the Pigeon mayhem? Check out our brand-new launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=ZsPV9NW8-1g;full][/previewyoutube]WHAT IS HEADBANGERS?
In Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, players battle through four rounds, with each round increasing in difficulty. In round one, 30 players go head-to-head, with only 20 players advancing to the second round of Headbangers. For the first round, a minigame is randomly selected out of the pool of first round minigames.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/2f9ba42869fb17e2478f1a6c7f6ba79e8c7b1aa6.gif
BE THE STAR OF A GAME SHOW!
One of the six first-round minigame options is ‘Guess it!’. In this minigame, your agility and musical ability are put to the test! The goal in ‘Guess it!’ is to select the instruments you hear in each musical excerpt as quickly as possible. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/5627ee98e982e378a4a7984022f4724c2ccbc547.gif

At the start of the minigame, you will hear one musical instrument per sequence. When the instrument wheel appears, select the instrument you just heard!

As the minigame progresses, musical sequences will get tougher! Each sequence will contain more musical instruments. At first, this jumps to two instruments per sequence. Near the end of the minigame, you’ll need to identify three instruments per sequence! Flock, we hope you know your maracas from the cello! 🤭

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/e71a81bb55563249ddcde1e1954f9282b11324c7.gif
A PIGEON FITNESS TEST?
In the second-round of Headbangers, new skills will be assessed! In ‘Fitness’, your memory and reactions will be tested as you soar into a pigeon fitness class. Your job is to memorise, and then reproduce the fitness coach’s moves and rhythm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/fd2803da0d96a96e46ee7f1ceca22219a1482d19.gif

At the start of ‘Fitness’, the coach will only move in one or two directions. This minigame is scored by how accurately you reproduce the coach’s movements. Your score is shown as a percentage at the end of each sequence, with the total accuracy shown in the top left corner!

Deeper into the round, the coach will move in many different directions, throwing in pauses along the way. Don’t get caught out by the coach repeating directions multiple times or by the coach’s sudden changes in movement! Only ten pigeon players can progress to the next round of Headbangers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/31261b619cdfadc5a4d4e7b7b6068019fd7d823e.gif
RACE TO THE FINISH!
Five Pigeon-players head into the final round of Headbangers. However, only one pigeon can claim the victory and become the Master Headbanger! In fourth and final round minigame ‘The Final Ride’, players' rhythm skills are tested! Your goal is to copy and play along with the rhythmic sequences to move your chariot forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/16a6ec9f3eb856784dcff75486652780d83c02c1.gif

Like many Headbangers minigames- as you get further into the minigame, the round will get harder! The tempo of each musical sequence will increase as you progress through ‘The Final Ride’. The amount of buttons you’ll need to hit per sequence will increase. Remember, the first pigeon to the finish wins the tournament!

‘The Final Ride’ is one of the five final-round minigame options. Headbangers has so much replayability, with 23 varied minigames at launch!

notes.content:
We are just hours away from the launch of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale! Are you ready to join the ✨ Big Pigeon Party? ✨

Headbangers launches at 5PM GMT on 31st October!

With the launch being so close, we wanted to share our FAQ page here on Steam! If you have any questions around Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please ask them in our Steam Discussions, our Headbangers Discord server or in the discussions below. 😄

HEADBANGERS RHYTHM ROYALE FAQs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/352b6d9e9164b8c1434a9ffd45b8111fa0d795a5.png
What is Headbangers Rhythm Royale?
Have you ever looked at a Pigeon and thought, “what is going on in your head?”
Well, think no more! Headbangers puts you and 29 others into the eye of the Pigeon while you battle it out in rhythmic challenges to find out who is the ultimate Master Headbanger.
Compete against each other in mind- bending musical minigames, screw over your competitors with powerups, and collect Crumbs to customise your very own Pigeon!

When will Headbangers release?
For Steam, Headbangers will release at 5PM GMT on October 31st.

How much will it cost?
The standard version of Headbangers Rhythm Royale is available for £19.99/$19.99/€19.99, with the Deluxe Edition being available for £29.99/$29.99/€29.99.

The Gold Edition is available for £34.99/$34.99/€34.99.

What do you get in the Deluxe Edition of Headbangers?
The Deluxe Edition of Headbangers includes the base game of Headbangers and the Season Pass (Pigeon Pass).

What do you get in the Gold Edition of Headbangers?
The Gold Edition of Headbangers includes the base game of Headbangers, two soundtracks of Headbangers music (Run Pigeon Run I & II and The Crumbs Collection) and the Season Pass (Pigeon Pass).

If you pre-purchased the deluxe edition you will have a free upgrade to the Gold Edition, as those who pre-purchased the deluxe edition will get the soundtrack.

What is the Season Pass / Pigeon Pass?
The ‘Pigeon Pass’ grants players access to three unique DLC packs. The first DLC pack available, ‘Flock & Roll’, features four full costumes, four garments, a taunt and five taunt voices, and one neck sound, with content for the two remaining DLC packs being available before April 2024.

Does Headbangers feature cross-play between platforms?
Cross-platform play is a feature of Headbangers, through our ‘Team17 friends’ features. This allows players to connect with friends and play rounds of Headbangers, no matter their platform of choice! 

Will there be updates after release?
Absolutely! Keep your pigeon eyes peeled on our social media accounts as we will be sharing more information about Season 2 and Season 3 in the upcoming months.

How many players can play in one lobby in Headbangers?
Headbangers has 30 pigeon player lobbies.

How many minigames does Headbangers have?
Headbangers contains 23 minigames that all test different skills, including your rhythm, accuracy, memory, reaction speed and even your ability to rap!

How many rounds do you play in each game of Headbangers?
Battle through four rounds of intense musical minigames each time you play Headbangers! Here’s a list of what minigames are available for each round of Headbangers:

Round 1: Garden Party, Guess it!, Guilty!, Run Pigeon Run I, Yes Commander!, Piano Mezzo Forte

I have some feedback for Headbangers! Where should I send this?
Please join our Headbangers Discord Server and head to the #feedback channel to leave your feedback! https://discord.gg/n35cwGy6nP 

What languages will Headbangers support at launch?
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Russian.

What are the System Requirements for Headbangers?
MINIMUM:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10. Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4350. Memory: 8 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730, 1 GB / AMD Radeon R7 240, 1 GB. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 2 GB available space.

RECOMMENDED:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10. Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-8370. Memory: 8 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GRX 650 Ti, 2 GB / AMD Radeon HD 7770, 2GB / Intel Arc A370M, 4GB. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 2 GB available space.

My controller is showing the incorrect inputs on Steam. How do I fix this?
For correct controller inputs on Steam whilst playing Headbangers, please do not use Steam inputs and plug your controller directly into your PC/device.

Will there be a Physical Release of Headbangers?
There are currently no plans for a physical release.

notes.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale launches 31st October 2023!
notes.content:
Hey there Flock! 👋
Today we revealed a first look at gameplay for rhythm-based battle royale game Headbangers: Rhythm Royale! Not only that, we also revealed that Headbangers: Rhythm Royale launches on 31st October 2023 for Steam! 

[previewyoutube=R_l_SQBmIEA;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot wait for you to get your beaks into Headbangers: Rhythm Royale and enjoy musical minigame chaos! Today we have some new im-peck-able information around Headbangers for you to soar into! 

Headbangers places players into the perfectly preened plumage of a pigeon, finally answering the age-old question, ‘What is going on in their head?’ Naturally, the answer is music through a series of increasingly tense rounds of chaotic musical minigames, which test a player’s memory, rhythm, reflexes, reaction time, and (obviously) their ability to rap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/afc974998bd2f489b575d4adc58750d1dae01175.gif

Headbangers Key Features:
23 Musical Minigames
Memory, rhythm, knowledge, reflexes, and reaction times will be put to the test across 23 minigames, each with their own unique musical twist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/820dcf54aac1c7bcd3cbbad8f75903e6f00f1043.gif

Players will showcase their im-peck-able memory skills by copying the commanders’ instructions in Yes Commander; play the piano with a slingshot (yes really) in First Piano Shooter; be the first off the mark and into the solar system in To The Sky; and much, much more across 23 musically inspired minigames.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/a85882127045606200e80b41bfb66fb6b8fe23b4.gif

Pigeon Customisation
With hundreds of unique items to choose from, including full outfits, hats, glasses, voices, and taunts, players can take the top spot and fluff their feathers with their very own personalised pigeon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/fc86aac052ec9efa4ed81656264dd0f7b9205faa.gif

Earn Breadcrumbs
Challenges and unlockable customisations await, with players able to spend their hard-earned crumbs to help them be the most stylish pigeon in the flock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/6454ac1da548d40a2de2dc0beb83cd8fae767bc3.gif

30 Pigeon Player Lobbies
Soar into mayhem and compete against up to 29 other avians! Remember, only one pigeon can become the Master Headbanger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/5f34fb8e19cf3f2f472e509b082d87addcb6da36.gif

All-Free Battle Pass
View XP progress in the all-free battle pass to unlock new customisation items for your pigeon. Battle pass items vary from full costumes, costume items, sounds, taunts, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/7a6e8700cbfcafd4c9989edb208b4c24f31e3cc3.gif

Crossplay for all!
Play with up to 30 pigeons on any platform. No matter your friend’s device of choice to play on, you can flock together, battling it out to see who is crowned the Master Headbanger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/b95e2574d85f2dbc860c72a432605722c608ce9f.gif
